SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, vendored for offline/local XLSX import and export.

Source: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js
Documentation: https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/standalone/
License: xlsx.LICENSE.txt (Apache-2.0).

Loaded on demand by features/metrics-excel.js. No spreadsheet data is sent to the library vendor.
